description: Without `champion`: the current-patch champion board (top `limit` rows by TrackDIFF's tier grade): rank, champion, games, win rate, pick rate, ban rate (all 0–1), tier grade (S+…D), roles played and worst matchups, optionally for one role and one rank bucket. With `champion`: that champion's headline stats, per-role split, and its board standing, pinnable to a `patch` like "16.17". Stats are ranked solo/duo from the games TrackDIFF tracks. For items/runes/skill order call `get_champion_build`.

patch.description: Only with `champion`: pin to a patch like "16.17".

rank_bucket.description: Rank scope, e.g. "DIAMOND_PLUS", "MASTER_PLUS". Omit for all ranks.

role.description: Riot team position: TOP, JUNGLE, MIDDLE, BOTTOM, UTILITY.

name: get_champion_stats
title: Champion win / pick / ban rates
